service.description: A contact file's text, from an upload (contactFile) or a resource location (fileLocation), in its character set: characterSet (UTF-8 by default; WINDOWS-1252, ISO-8859-1 or any other Java or WHATWG name, read by the framework's FileItem.getString and stream getText), except that a file that starts with a UTF-16 byte order mark is read as UTF-16 whatever was chosen, and UTF-16 chosen for a file without one is read little-endian, as Windows writes it. The byte order mark is not in text. characterSetUsed is the set the file was read in. text is null for a location with no file. read#ContactRows reads its file so, and an app that keeps the file's text (IronStone BOSS's import draft) reads it with this service.

The file's columns and its rows, each mapped to a contact (the map ContactBookServices.store#ContactParty takes, with groupNames and isFavorite) with its problems. A column maps to a target field (targetFieldList): firstName, lastName, fullName, organizationName, jobTitle, birthday, notes, groups and the like, or a numbered email, phone, address or website slot with a part and an optional fixed purpose (email1, email1.label, address2.city, phone3:PhoneMobile). presetId (google, outlook, generic; found from the headers when empty) maps the columns, and columnMapping overrides it per column (an empty target or 'ignore' leaves a column out). An upload or a location is read in characterSet by read#ContactFileText.

parameter.name: fileText
parameter.description: The file's text, parsed by the framework tool, never shown as HTML; real vCard and ICS files hold < (Apple labels, HTML descriptions)

parameter.name: columnMapping
parameter.description: Column name to target field

parameter.name: defaultCountryGeoId
parameter.description: The country of addresses without one

parameter.name: maxRows
parameter.description: Map only this many rows (rowCount counts them all)

parameter.name: fileKind
parameter.description: csv or vcard

parameter.name: column
parameter.description: columnIndex, columnName, targetField, sampleValues

parameter.name: row
parameter.description: rowNumber (from 1), values (column to text), contact, problems, empty

parameter.name: targetField
parameter.description: fieldName, description

service.description: The import's first step: the file's kind, the preset found (or given), its columns each with the target field it maps to and sample values, the first rows, and the row count.

parameter.name: fileText
parameter.description: The file's text, parsed by the framework tool, never shown as HTML; real vCard and ICS files hold < (Apple labels, HTML descriptions)

actions.script: const read = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.party.ContactImportServices.read#ContactRows').parameters({contactFile: contactFile, fileText: fileText, fileLocation: fileLocation, fileName: fileName, characterSet: characterSet, presetId: presetId, maxRows: sampleSize}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return fileKind = read.fileKind presetId = read.presetId columnList = read.columnList columnMapping = read.columnMapping rowCount = read.rowCount targetFieldList = read.targetFieldList sampleRowList = (read.contactList || []).map((row) => row.values)

service.description: The existing party a contact matches, among those the user may see (the entity filters, not disabled, and a personal contact only its owner's): by a current email address (ignoring case), else by a phone number (the last ten digits, at least seven) of a party whose first or last name, or organization name, is the contact's too (a shared office number is not a match), else by name (a person's first and last name, an organization's name) when exactly one party has it.

parameter.name: matchedPseudoId
parameter.description: The matched party's pseudoId, the id to show

parameter.name: matchReason
parameter.description: email, phone or name

parameter.name: matchedName
parameter.description: The matched party's name alone (PartyNameOnlyTemplate), without an id

service.description: What import#Contacts would do with each row, without writing: action create, update or skip (by the duplicate policy for a row that matches an existing party, or an earlier row of the file by email), the matched party, and the row's problems. A row with nothing to import is skipped.

parameter.name: fileText
parameter.description: The file's text, parsed by the framework tool, never shown as HTML; real vCard and ICS files hold < (Apple labels, HTML descriptions)

parameter.name: duplicatePolicy
parameter.description: skip, update or create

parameter.name: row
parameter.description: rowNumber, action, matchedPartyId, matchedPseudoId, matchedName (the name alone), matchReason, matchedRowNumber, name, contact, problems

service.description:
Imports the rows of a contact file as personal contacts (asPersonal, the default: seen only by the user, into one of the user's personal books, the default book when contactBookId is empty) or as directory parties (with roleTypeId, into contactBookId when given). A row matching an existing party (match#Contact, which also finds the parties earlier rows created) is skipped, updated (empty fields filled, new emails, phones and addresses added; the data of a directory party changes only in a directory import) or created anyway, by duplicatePolicy. Each row is imported in its own transaction: a row that fails is reported in failureList and the rest are imported. The file's groups (labels, categories) and groupNames become groups of the book.
With progressUserId, how far it is goes to that user as a NotificationMessage on the topic contactImportProgress (not persisted unless the topic says so), every 25 rows and once at the end: {progressKey, done, total, createdCount, updatedCount, skippedCount, failedCount, finished}. A message that cannot be sent is logged and the import goes on.

parameter.name: fileText
parameter.description: The file's text, parsed by the framework tool, never shown as HTML; real vCard and ICS files hold < (Apple labels, HTML descriptions)

parameter.name: duplicatePolicy
parameter.description: skip, update or create

parameter.name: roleTypeId
parameter.description: The role of new directory parties

parameter.name: groupNames
parameter.description: Comma-separated groups every imported contact gets, created in the book when missing

parameter.name: progressUserId
parameter.description: The user who gets the progress messages

parameter.name: progressKey
parameter.description: Names this import in the progress messages, such as the caller's import id

parameter.name: failure
parameter.description: rowNumber, values, error

parameter.name: result
parameter.description: rowNumber, action, partyId, matchedPartyId

service.description: One row of import#Contacts, which runs it in its own transaction: match, then skip, update or create by the duplicate policy, then add the party to the book and groups.

parameter.name: action
parameter.description: create, update or skip

parameter.name: format
